scope: One original greeting expression per card; same learning sequence, language-specific source and support.
audioProtocol: GUIDED_AUDIO_PROTOCOL.md plus approved A0 GLR 001 pilot rule in LEVEL_0_PRODUCTION_PROTOCOL.md: five cycles, >=max(2.5×voice,3s) gap, then separate on-card response prompt

cards.title: Say Hello
cards.situation: An adult learner arrives at a neighborhood café and meets a staff member at the door.
cards.physicalCue: The customer and staff member smile and raise a hand in greeting.
cards.pictureAlt: A customer and café worker smile and greet each other at the entrance.
cards.learnerInput: Hear a natural adult English greeting while seeing the two people meet.
cards.learnerOutput: Say “Hello!” to the café worker, first after the model and then after the visual prompt alone.
cards.tinyPrompt: 카페 직원이 웃으며 인사해요. 뭐라고 답할까요?
cards.optionalPronunciationSupport: HEL-loh — keep the second syllable clear; do not draw out the word.
cards.a1BridgeSkill: Greet someone with a supported response.

cards.title: Say Hello in Korean
cards.situation: An adult learner enters a small local café and meets an unfamiliar Korean staff member.
cards.physicalCue: The customer and staff member smile and exchange a gentle greeting at the door.
cards.pictureAlt: A customer and café worker greet each other at the entrance of a neighborhood café.
cards.learnerInput: Hear a polite everyday Korean greeting while seeing the two adults meet.
cards.learnerOutput: Say “안녕하세요” to the staff member, first after the model and then after the visual prompt alone.
cards.tinyPrompt: A café worker smiles and greets you. What do you say?
cards.optionalPronunciationSupport: 안녕-하세요 (annyeonghaseyo); listen to the complete spoken phrase before looking at the spelling.
cards.register: polite everyday greeting to an unfamiliar adult; not informal 안녕
cards.a1BridgeSkill: Greet an unfamiliar adult politely with a supported response.

reference.section: PDF pages 3–4 and 7: beginner self-introduction and polite greeting setting; used for register and scenario only
